opening.argument: The video presents a practical customer-support workflow, showing how to connect Facebook Messenger and live chat with a WordPress website: "today in our tutorial we are learning how to connect Facebook messenger and Livechat as well as Wordpress website". It also explains a Messenger auto-reply plugin that responds to Facebook users' comments and demonstrates saving settings for display on desktop and mobile. A Facebook login interface for chatting with GrowBig appears within that plugin and page-connection workflow, but the described material does not establish that the page is unauthentic, that credentials were submitted, or that harm occurred.
